fusions.name: Drowning Hold
fusions.desc: Only strikes a target at or below 30% health, a threshold that rises with each rank. You drag it under for 24 damage and use up every affliction on it, adding 1.4 times the damage they had left to deal.

fusions.name: The Long Wait
fusions.desc: After holding still for 1.5 seconds, you bite for 34 damage and leave the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 6% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Go Under
fusions.desc: For 4 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you.

fusions.name: Scent of the Faltering
fusions.desc: Your damage rises by 15% against enemies below half health.
